verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents a built-in, first-party MCP server that lets AI assistants build flows, manage tables and test automations. Its MCP page says Claude, Cursor, Codex or any MCP client can connect and drive the whole platform. A probe confirms the official MCP docs exist, and an embeddable MCP variant gives one-click authorization and a token for embedded users. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration that connecting an agent works as described.
